caseName: National Equipment Rental, Ltd. v. Szukhent
caseNameFull: National Equipment Rental, Ltd. v. Szukhent
attorneys: Wilbur G. Silver-man for petitioner. David Hartfield, Jr., John D. Calhoun, Benjamin C. Milner’III, Merrell E. Clark, Jr. and Henry L. King for Bankers Trust Co. et al., as amici curiae, in support of the petition.
